market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool have a strong squad and finished 3rd in 2024-25. With the core largely intact and a settled manager, they are likely top-4 contenders again in 2025-26. A 75% true probability seems conservative, whereas the market implies only 52.5%, suggesting underpricing.
evidence_points: Liverpool finished 3rd in 2024-25 with a high points tally
Squad depth and key players (Salah, Van Dijk, Alisson) remain world-class
Bookmakers typically price Liverpool top-4 around 1.25–1.40 (~71-80% implied probability)
sources_consulted: General knowledge of EPL standings and team strength for 2024-25
Typical betting odds for top-4 markets
